label: AXP2101 Battery Dashboard
info: Reads battery voltage, state of charge, charge state, VBUS and die temperature from an AXP2101 every 5 s. A function node keeps the last VBUS state and adds a vbus_event field (inserted / removed) whenever it changes, and a debug node prints the result. Demonstrates a battery and charger dashboard. Adjust the I2C bus and address in the device config node; set a charge voltage / current there only if you know your cell's limits (the 4.35 V and 4.4 V options are for high-voltage Li-ion cells only).
